title: Cook and Count Letters
hook: Shelf by shelf, what can you see?
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: 3D preschool cooking-tools storybook, bright utensils and ingredients, child-safe presentation, segmentation-friendly spacing

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: picture-game learner with a supervising grown-up implied
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: two-line memory anchor whose orchestration changes on repeat
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 names foods and object jobs from pictures. Hot, sharp or powered equipment is described, never operated by the child.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 is picture recall only: safe foods may get shape motions, while hot, sharp or powered tools get pointing or empty-hand mime only.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: muted woodblock, cup-tap or marimba answer; no appliance noise under vocals.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: muted woodblock, cup-tap or marimba answer; no appliance noise under vocals
